stab someone in the back: I trusted him completely, so I never thought he would stab someone in the back to get a promotion.
我完全信任他，所以從沒想過他會為了升遷而在背後捅人一刀。
have a stab at: I have never baked bread before, but I'd like to have a stab at it this weekend.
我以前從沒烤過麵包，但這週末我想試一試。
a stab of pain: While running up the stairs, he suddenly felt a sharp stab of pain in his left knee.
跑上樓梯時，他左膝突然感到一陣尖銳的刺痛。
stab at the keyboard: Angry about the slow computer, my brother began to stab at the keyboard with one finger.
因為電腦很慢而生氣，我弟弟開始用一根手指猛戳鍵盤。
a stab in the dark: I didn't know the answer to the last question, so my choice was just a stab in the dark.
我不知道最後一題的答案，所以我的選擇只是瞎猜。
stack the odds against: Bad weather and an injured captain seemed to stack the odds against our team in the final match.
惡劣的天氣和受傷的隊長似乎使我們隊在決賽中的勝算渺茫。
stack up against: Before buying a phone, I read reviews to see how this model would stack up against other brands.
買手機前，我會看評論，了解這款機型與其他品牌相比如何。
stack the cards: The players got angry when they caught the dealer trying to stack the cards before the game began.
玩家們發現發牌員在遊戲開始前試圖作弊洗牌，都很生氣。
stack the shelves: Every morning before the store opens, workers stack the shelves with fresh bread, milk, and fruit.
每天早上商店開門前，員工會上架補貨，擺上新鮮的麵包、牛奶和水果。
the odds are stacked: Small farmers know the odds are stacked against them when big companies control most of the market.
小農們知道，當大公司控制大部分市場時，勝算對他們很不公平。
staff a hotel: It is hard to staff a hotel with enough cleaners and cooks during the busy summer season.
在繁忙的夏季，很難為飯店配置足夠的清潔人員和廚師。
staff the hotline: Volunteers take turns to staff the hotline so that someone can answer calls for help all night.
志工們輪流負責接聽專線，讓整晚都有人能接聽求助電話。
fully staffed: After hiring five new waiters last week, the busy restaurant is finally fully staffed again.
上週雇用了五名新服務生後，這家生意興隆的餐廳終於又人員齊全了。
stage a protest: After weeks of planning and practice, the students decided to stage a protest outside city hall.
經過數週的計畫和練習，學生們決定在市政府外面舉行抗議。
stage a comeback: After losing for three seasons, the old boxer hopes to stage a comeback and win the title again.
連輸三個賽季後，這位老拳擊手希望能東山再起，再次贏得冠軍頭銜。
stage a play: Every December, our drama club works hard to stage a play for the parents in the school hall.
每年十二月，我們戲劇社都努力在學校禮堂為家長上演戲劇。
stage an event: The city plans to stage an event in the park to celebrate the opening of the new library.
市政府計畫在公園舉辦活動，慶祝新圖書館開幕。
stage a coup: Army leaders tried to stage a coup against the president, but the people refused to support them.
軍方領袖試圖發動政變推翻總統，但人民拒絕支持他們。
stage a strike: The bus drivers threatened to stage a strike if the company refused to raise their pay.
公車司機們威脅說，如果公司拒絕加薪，他們就要發動罷工。
stain one's reputation: Like a drop of ink on a white shirt, one lie can stain your reputation for many years.
就像白襯衫上的一滴墨水，一個謊言就能玷污你的名聲好多年。
stain the carpet: Be careful with that cup of coffee, or you will stain the carpet in the living room.
小心那杯咖啡，不然你會弄髒客廳的地毯。
stain wood: You should stain wood with a light brown color before building the bookshelf so it looks warm.
在做書架之前，你應該先把木頭染成淺棕色，讓它看起來很溫暖。
a stain on one's record: Getting caught cheating left a stain on his record that his future employers might notice.
作弊被抓在他的紀錄上留下了污點，未來的雇主可能會注意到。
stake a claim: Several countries have tried to stake a claim to the small island because of the oil near it.
因為附近有石油，好幾個國家都試圖主張對這座小島的所有權。
stake one's reputation on: The famous chef was ready to stake his reputation on the new dish, saying it was his best ever.
那位知名主廚願意以名譽擔保這道新菜，說它是他做過最好的一道。
stake money on: My uncle loves soccer, but he is too careful to stake money on any game.
我叔叔熱愛足球，但他太謹慎，不會押注在任何比賽上。
at stake: With the championship at stake, every player gave everything they had in the final minutes.
冠軍岌岌可危之際，每位球員在最後幾分鐘都使出了全力。
have a stake in: Parents have a stake in how schools are run, so they should be invited to share their opinions.
家長和學校的經營方式有利害關係，所以應該邀請他們分享意見。
raise the stakes: The company decided to raise the stakes by offering a million-dollar prize to the best app designer.
公司決定提高賭注，為最佳應用程式設計師提供一百萬元的獎金。
